audit.reason: Open draft pull requests are not merged product history and cannot be included in a release candidate.

releases.title: The open method and assessment-to-artifact system
releases.summary: Established Reality Architect as an open five-move method, a local system-gap assessment, an exportable architecture brief, and a production public site with explicit privacy, evidence, canonical-host, and quality-gate contracts.
highlights: Introduced the See, Design, Build, Automate, and Compound loop together with the open reality.md standard and forkable starter artifacts.
Turned the local five-move assessment into an exportable Markdown architecture brief with the first unmet dependency, next artifact, acceptance test, guardrail, and seven-day build order.

Added a proof-led Loop map, typography and interaction polish, technical-blueprint illustrations, canonical metadata, stable sitemap and robots output, security headers, accessibility, and reduced-motion behavior.
Removed unsupported superlatives, fake capture success, unverified Vault scarcity/pricing, and unattended-operation claims while separating the public method from the private paid Vault.
Installed the web-excellence gate and an exact-head full CI contract using the declared Node 24 and pnpm 11.5.0 toolchain.

sourcePullRequests.title: Add the proof-led Architect Loop hero

limitations: This is a reviewed release candidate record, not a tag or published GitHub release; status must change to ready in a reviewed main-branch commit before tagging.
The public site still returns 404 for /changelog. A customer-facing history requires a separate premium visual, accessibility, performance, and exact-head preview lane.

The open public method does not expose private Vault content, transmit or persist assessment context, promise unattended outcomes, or prove any paid offer, provider, pricing, scarcity, or enrollment state.
Open draft PRs #1, #4, #11, and #12 are excluded from this dated history until they merge through current review and evidence gates.
